mechanism_narrative: Lower federal funds rates (FEDFUNDS) compress equity discount rates and increase present value of future cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of rate level.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 4.5% and 20-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%) triggers central bank tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5% and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad economic contraction, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both decline by >0.5% from prior month and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 4.0%) signals weak labor market conditions that reduce consumer confidence and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 4.0% and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production (INDPRO > 102.0) indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.0 and 5-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts (HOUST < 1600) signal reduced residential investment and consumer wealth, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST < 1600 and 20-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 102.0) supports corporate earnings momentum, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO > 102.0 and 60-day forward returns are negative in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 QoQ < 1.0%) indicates economic deceleration that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 (QoQ) < 1.0% and 60-day forward returns are positive in >55% of instances over any 2-year rolling window.
